articles.source: mint - companies
articles.summary: Google is prioritizing AI development over short-term cloud revenue.
articles.explain: DeepMind is Google’s advanced artificial intelligence research laboratory. By shifting resources, Google is betting that long-term leadership in AI technology will eventually be more profitable than immediate fees from cloud-computing customers.

story.title: Google Prioritizes AI Over Cloud Revenue
story.so_far: Google's parent company, Alphabet, is heavily investing in Generative AI, a field where they are competing against companies like OpenAI and Microsoft. Cloud computing is a major revenue stream where companies rent processing power to other businesses.

timeline.text: CEO Sundar Pichai stated that the company is allocating computing resources to DeepMind for AI research, potentially limiting cloud capacity for 2027.

articles.summary: The Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) has opened a BSL-3 laboratory for infectious disease research.
articles.explain: Biosafety levels are standardized, escalating safety precautions used in laboratories. BSL-3 facilities feature specialized ventilation and security protocols to ensure that dangerous bacteria or viruses do not escape into the environment.

story.title: MAHE Launches BSL-3 Research Facility
story.so_far: Bio-Safety Level 3 (BSL-3) labs are specialized facilities designed for working with microbes that can cause serious or potentially lethal diseases through inhalation.

timeline.text: A new BSL-3 facility has been inaugurated to conduct research on dangerous pathogens under strict containment.

articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: The Gujarat government has declared four districts drought-hit following insufficient rainfall.
articles.explain: Drought occurs when an area receives significantly less rainfall than average over an extended period. Declaring an area 'drought-hit' allows the government to unlock emergency funds and resources to assist farmers and protect livestock.

story.title: Gujarat Drought Relief Measures
story.so_far: Agriculture is a primary livelihood in many parts of rural India, making it highly susceptible to rainfall patterns. State governments typically provide direct financial support during drought years to stabilize rural economies.

story.title: PTC India Mineral Exchange Plans

articles.title: Hunter’s Moon 2026: Why it looks bigger and orange
articles.source: Economic Times
articles.summary: The 'Hunter's Moon' appears larger and more orange due to its proximity to the horizon.
articles.explain: When the moon is near the horizon, it often looks larger because of a psychological 'moon illusion' combined with the fact that its light passes through more of Earth's atmosphere, which scatters shorter wavelengths and leaves more of the orange/red spectrum visible.

story.title: 2026 Hunter's Moon Phenomenon
story.so_far: The Hunter's Moon is a traditional name for the first full moon following the harvest moon. The apparent size and color shift are common optical phenomena.

timeline.text: The full moon is currently exhibiting the 'moon illusion' and atmospheric scattering effects.

articles.title: Does a company have a guilty mind?
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: The Supreme Court of India has established criteria to determine corporate criminal intent.
articles.explain: Because companies cannot 'think' like humans, the courts create rules to decide if a company’s actions (like fraud or negligence) were deliberate. This three-fold test provides judges with a consistent framework to prove that a corporation intended to break the law, rather than just having a process go wrong by accident.

story.title: Supreme Court Ruling on Corporate Intent
story.so_far: In law, 'mens rea' (Latin for 'guilty mind') is a core element of criminal liability. For corporations, which are legal 'persons' but not human beings, determining intent has long been a complex legal challenge.

timeline.text: The court introduced a three-fold test to evaluate whether a company can be held legally responsible for 'guilty mind' (mens rea) in criminal cases.

articles.explain: A 'rights entitlement' is a financial instrument that gives a shareholder the right to buy new shares. Selling these entitlements suggests the investor (in this case, SoftBank) does not want to put more money into the company at this time.

story.title: Ola Electric Rights Issue
story.so_far: Ola Electric is a major player in the Indian EV space. A rights issue allows existing shareholders to purchase additional shares at a discount to raise capital for the company, but it can also signal that the firm needs liquidity to cover ongoing losses.

articles.source: Cointelegraph.com News
articles.summary: The market cap for Securitize's tokenized stocks has declined as competitors like Circle gain market share.
articles.explain: Market capitalization (market cap) is the total value of all the tokens currently in circulation. A 'tokenized stock' is a digital asset that is intended to track the price of a real-world stock share, allowing for potentially faster and more transparent trading on crypto platforms.

story.title: Opposition to OKX-ICE Tokenized Stock Platform
story.so_far: Tokenized stocks are digital representations of traditional shares issued on a blockchain. The industry is currently competing to become the standard for trading these assets, facing regulatory hurdles and shifting investor preferences.
